title: [R&D FEATURE SPEC] Group Collaborative Trip Planning with Live WebSocket Sync
user_problem_solved: Product defect impacting traveler experience or system safety.

cross_platform_parity.web: Must provide interactive visual confirmation, clear warnings on invalid inputs, and real-time map updates.
cross_platform_parity.android: Must update local Hive cache and notify connected Android Auto head unit via CarNavState bridge.
cross_platform_parity.ios: Must maintain voice guidance maneuver queue integrity via CarPlayVoiceGuidance bridge.
cross_platform_parity.backend: Must enforce strict deterministic API contract and schema validation.

value_assessment: CRITICAL: Guarantees spatial correctness and preserves core brand promise of zero-hallucination travel planning.
complexity_risk: MEDIUM: Must protect existing trip creation and saved trips while adding deterministic boundary validation.
